wiki.title: Conor Casey (politician)
wiki.extract: Conor Casey is an American politician from Vermont. He has been a Democratic member of the Vermont House of Representatives for the Washington-4 district since 2023. Casey is also a playwright. His satirical historical comedy Founding F%!#ers: The Story of Ethan Allen and Benedict Arnold had its premiere at the Greater Boston Stage Company in Stoneham, Massachusetts, in May 2025.
